assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D WWII strategy-game infantry sprite. Input images 1 (Infantry01), 2 (Infantry02), and 3 (JapaneseInfantry02) are STYLE, CAMERA, PROPORTION references only. Create ONE new Soviet Red Army rifleman, facing DOWN toward bottom of canvas. STRICT directly overhead 90-degree orthographic camera matching these tiny references: round helmet centered and hides the face and chest; compact shoulders around helmet, visible short legs/boots, human form seen from directly above, NOT front view or isometric. Match reference 1 and 2's chunky low-resolution pixel-sprite drawing, thick near-black outlines, only few large muted color/shadow blocks, very simple details, not smooth painted illustration. Soviet khaki-olive gymnastyorka tunic and trousers, darker olive simple rounded SSh-style steel helmet, brown leather belt and minimal ammunition pouches, small muted khaki pack at back. Tiny tan hands. Main silhouette: both hands hold a long straight wood-stock Mosin-style bolt-action rifle along LEFT side of body, dark narrow barrel projecting DOWN toward bottom; rifle straight, thin, readable. One compact standing/ready soldier only. Dark subdued olive/khaki palette clearly different from German blue-grey, no camouflage, no netting, no bright green. Helmet about half shoulder width. Match tight top-down foreshortening, simple solid shadows and coarse pixel scale of reference 1. Designed to read at 24-32 px tall, no fine texture. Entire figure and rifle fully visible, centered with 8 percent transparent padding on all sides. No visible face, no portrait, no front view, no text, no badge closeup, no ground, no cast shadow, no scenery, no panels, no frame, no other soldiers, no checkerboard matte. Genuine transparent alpha background.
